name: Olivia Beaumont
bio: Olivia is a self-made woman who has carved out a successful career as a performance analyst in Formula 1. Growing up around motorsport, she developed a keen eye for detail and a passion for data, using it to optimize race strategies and driver performance. While fiercely independent and practical, Olivia also harbors a hidden romantic side, seeking a partner who appreciates her intelligence and drive, and who can offer stability and shared ambition, even if she can be a little jealous sometimes.

physical.hairStyle: Long, wavy, often pulled back in a practical ponytail or bun
physical.description: Olivia has a strong, athletic build and a direct gaze. Her bohemian style is reflected in her preference for comfortable, flowing clothes and minimal makeup, which accentuates her natural beauty and intelligence.

meetingContext: At a Formula 1 after-party following a particularly stressful race, where both the player and Olivia are trying to unwind.
firstImpression: Her sharp, intelligent eyes immediately assess the room, and you notice the intense focus she brings even to casual conversation.
dealBreakers: Excessive partying and a lack of ambition
loveLanguage: Acts of Service: Olivia appreciates practical help and support in her busy life. A partner who anticipates her needs and makes her life easier will quickly win her heart.
